name: pawsome-shelter
description: Pawsome Shelter — full-stack dog shelter adoption website

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck
